fidelity: F2a — Reaction Kinetics + Lumped Reactor Energy Balance ODE
description: Arrhenius kinetics with equilibrium-driven conversion coupled to a 0D lumped reactor energy balance. Charge = endothermic dehydration Ca(OH)2 -> CaO + H2O; Discharge = exothermic hydration CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2.
source: Schaube et al. (2012) Thermochim. Acta 538:9-20 (CaO/Ca(OH)2 kinetics & equilibrium); N'Tsoukpoe et al. (2009) Renew. Sust. Energy Rev. 13:2385 (long-term loss-free storage); Wentworth & Chen (1976) Solar Energy 18:205 (chemical heat pump/storage); Pardo et al. (2014) Renew. Sust. Energy Rev. 32:591.

m_active.note: Mass of reactive CaO/Ca(OH)2 storage material (Pardo 2014)

dS_rxn.note: Reaction entropy, sets equilibrium temperature via van't Hoff (Schaube 2012)

A_pre_charge.note: Arrhenius pre-exponential factor, dehydration/charge; tuned so k~3e-3/s at 790K (Schaube 2012 Ea, lumped fit)

A_pre_discharge.note: Arrhenius pre-exponential factor, hydration/discharge; tuned so k~3e-3/s at 660K (Schaube 2012 Ea, lumped fit)

cp_solid.note: Specific heat of CaO/Ca(OH)2 solid bed (Schaube 2013)

cp_reactor.note: Specific heat of reactor steel structure

hA_ext.note: Reactor-to-source heat exchange coefficient * area (HTF or heat loss)
